overview: The Committee of the Whole reviewed a long-standing public tree ordinance intended to protect and sustain the city's tree canopy. The committee voted to refer the ordinance to the regular meeting with amendments concerning resident notification and penalty calculations.

items.title: Public Tree Ordinance (Item 19-070)
items.summary: Referred the ordinance to the regular meeting with an amendment to refine resident notification requirements and instructions to clarify canopy loss penalty calculations with the Department of Public Works and legal counsel.
